title: Virtual Compute: snapshot review — backup reduction
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute snapshot review — Read portfolio price reduction fraction of the same-entity active backup tier as the non-stacking shared-snapshot base-price reduction; absent active backup gives zero reduction.
